Aidoc, a clinical AI medical imaging provider, raised $150 million in Series E funding, CEO Elad Walach tells Axios Pro exclusively.
**The big picture:**[Radiology](https://www.axios.com/pro/all-deals/2025/12/19/clinical-decision-support-openevidence-doximity) is one of AI's earliest and most established use cases at scale in health care.
